claim_scores.rationale: Uses both `program(...)` and direct `program.cot(...)`, matching the required `Module.__call__` paths for parent and child.
Asserts `id(program.history[0]) == id(program.cot.history[0])`, correctly proving the nested call shares one history entry object.
Correctly asserts the post-call lengths: parent `1`, child `2`, predictor `2` after one parent call and one direct submodule call.
Sets `disable_history=True`, makes another call, and verifies all three histories stay at `1`, `2`, and `2`, proving no new entries are recorded.
